clue.text: Spend a long time making journeys

parts.note: to spend time is to pass it
ages is a colloquial term for a long time

explanation.surface: Someone spends ages travelling about.
explanation.definitionFit: Passages are voyages or crossings, especially by sea, so they are trips.

clue.text: Penny gets everyone fruit

parts.note: each means every one

explanation.surface: Penny hands out fruit to all.
explanation.walkthrough: Penny looks like a girl's name; it gives the coin's abbreviation P.
explanation.definitionFit: A peach is a soft, downy stone fruit.

clue.text: Hurry to acquire healthy plant

parts.note: to speed is to hurry
well means healthy

explanation.surface: Rush out to buy a thriving plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Speedwell, or veronica, is a small wild flower with blue blooms.

clue.text: Refuse to leave bishop in service station

indicators.note: in places the bishop inside the service station

parts.note: a garage is a place selling fuel and doing repairs
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A clergyman will not leave a petrol station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' reads as the verb, will not; it is the noun, rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Garbage is rubbish thrown away, waste.

clue.text: What short-staffed publicans may have to do?

definitions.text: What short-staffed publicans may have to do?

parts.words: What short-staffed publicans may have to do?
parts.note: short-staffed reads as lacking workers, but a barrel built of staves that is short of beer must be scraped to its last drop

explanation.surface: Pubs with too few workers face a struggle.
explanation.walkthrough: A barrel is made of staves; the idiom means resorting to the last and worst resources.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means using whatever poor resources remain, as a pub low on staff or beer must.

clue.text: Cut the cackle when incarcerated

explanation.surface: Being locked up as a reason to stop chattering.
explanation.definitionFit: To stop talking is a slang order of silence, and someone confined in prison is locked away, two senses of the same phrase.

clue.text: Mistrust American priest in church faction

indicators.note: in places the American and priest inside the church faction

parts.note: a sect is a breakaway faction of a church

explanation.surface: An American cleric is distrusted within a breakaway church group.
explanation.definitionFit: To suspect is to doubt or have misgivings about someone.

clue.text: Minor investigation about WW2 rocket

indicators.note: about says the investigation goes around the rocket

parts.note: a trial is a judicial examination of a case
the V1 was a German flying bomb of World War Two, written VI with a Roman numeral

explanation.surface: A small inquiry into a wartime missile.
explanation.definitionFit: Trivial means of little importance, small and insignificant.

clue.text: Following delivery of mail to s. African province

parts.note: post is mail
Natal was a province of South Africa

explanation.surface: Letters are sent on to a region of South Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Delivery' suggests the postman; it is childbirth.
explanation.definitionFit: Postnatal describes the period after giving birth.

clue.text: A nobleman called to present himself

indicators.note: called out loud, so the words a nobleman are to be heard rather than read

parts.note: A plus peer, a member of the nobility

explanation.surface: An aristocrat is summoned to attend in person.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, A PEER gives the sound of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To present oneself somewhere is to show up or come into view.

clue.text: They make tea for girl cheerleaders

parts.note: Rose is a girl's name
hip is the word that leads a cheer, as in hip hip hooray

explanation.surface: A tea party is laid on for some young female cheerleaders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheerleaders' suggests pom-pom squads, but the leaders of a cheer are the hips of hip hip hooray.
explanation.definitionFit: The fruit of the wild rose is dried and infused to brew a herbal drink.

clue.text: Leading light

parts.note: head means leading, as in head waiter
a lamp is a light

explanation.surface: A prominent figure in some field.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase usually means an eminent person; read literally, it is the lamp at the front of a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A headlamp is the front lamp of a car, lighting the way ahead, so a light that leads.

clue.text: Some wrens ignore us officer

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some members of the women's navy pay no attention to an American officer.
explanation.walkthrough: Wrens are members of the old Women's Royal Naval Service, a fitting naval surface.
explanation.definitionFit: In the United States Navy the lowest commissioned rank carries this title.

clue.text: Can't seem to repair the window

indicators.note: repairing means putting the letters of can't seem back together in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone is unable to fix the window.
explanation.definitionFit: A casement is a window hinged at the side that opens outwards.

clue.text: Letter-card

explanation.surface: A one-word puzzle pairing a written symbol with a playing card.
explanation.definitionFit: A written symbol such as an alphabet sign is a character, and an eccentric, amusing person is called a card or a character.

clue.text: Bar Catholic journal

explanation.surface: A pub banning a religious magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: A tablet is a flat bar of soap or chocolate, and The Tablet is a long-running Catholic weekly published in London.

clue.text: Punter gets away with more cash

parts.note: a punter is a gambler, one who bets
off means away, as in going off

explanation.surface: A gambler leaves with winnings.
explanation.definitionFit: Being financially more comfortable means having more money than before.

clue.text: Bush producing a drink in Zaire

indicators.note: in places the drink inside the letters for Zaire

parts.note: ZA is the international vehicle code formerly associated with Zaire in crosswords
ale is a drink

explanation.surface: A shrub turns out a beverage in central Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bush' reads as a wild African landscape beside Zaire, but it defines a garden shrub; ZA is the conventional crossword abbreviation used for Zaire.
explanation.definitionFit: An azalea is a flowering shrub of the rhododendron family.

clue.text: Arabian contender makes an appearance

parts.note: a rival is a contender

explanation.surface: An Arab racehorse in the running turns up at the course.
explanation.definitionFit: Turning up somewhere is coming into view, an entrance on the scene.

clue.text: Judo buff enters before slow movement

indicators.note: enters says the judo expert goes inside the word for before

parts.note: ante is Latin for before, as in ante-room
a dan is a grade of expert in judo and other martial arts

explanation.surface: A martial-arts enthusiast arrives ahead of a gentle passage of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Movement' is a section of a symphony, not physical motion.
explanation.definitionFit: Andante is a musical tempo marking meaning at a walking pace, and names a moderately slow section of a work.

clue.text: Ultimate net value worked out

indicators.note: worked out means the letters of net value are rearranged into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A final figure is calculated for the net worth of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Something eventual happens at the end, so it is final.

clue.text: To clarify matters was once simple

parts.note: ex- means former, what was once
plain means simple

explanation.surface: A clarification that the issue used to be straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: To make something clear is to set out the reasons and details so others understand.

clue.text: First members of abba on way to, say, Sweden

indicators.note: the first members are the opening pair of letters of abba

parts.note: a road is a way

explanation.surface: The front of a Swedish pop group heading off overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: ABBA was a Swedish pop group, fitting the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Going overseas or to a foreign country such as Sweden is going out of the country.

clue.text: Perfect dessert

explanation.surface: A flawless pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: Apple-pie order means faultless neatness, and the baked fruit tart is a classic pudding.

clue.text: Eastern pole required to make investment

parts.note: N is the north pole
due means owed or required

explanation.surface: An Eastern European official is needed to put money in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Investment' is not finance: to endue is to invest someone with a quality or garment.
explanation.definitionFit: To endue is to invest or endow someone with a quality, an old sense of clothing.

clue.text: Local host who composed church music

explanation.surface: A pub landlord who also wrote sacred works.
explanation.walkthrough: A local is a British pub; John Taverner was a 16th-century English composer of church music.
explanation.definitionFit: A taverner keeps an inn, a landlord, and John Taverner wrote Tudor masses.

clue.text: A canon in circulation

parts.note: a round is a musical canon, voices entering in turn with the same melody

explanation.surface: A churchman going about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Canon' looks like a clergyman; it is a musical form.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is about is current or going round.

clue.text: Tell tales about Tralee

indicators.note: about means the letters of Tralee are moved around

explanation.surface: Stories are told of an Irish town.
explanation.walkthrough: Tralee is a town in County Kerry, Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate is to narrate or recount a story.

clue.text: Yearn to confront fellow-expert giving sullen looks

definitions.note: plural in the clue, while the phrase is singular as an expression

indicators.note: to confront puts the yearning word facing what follows, so it comes in front

parts.note: to long is to yearn
an ace is an expert

explanation.surface: Someone wanting to face down a colleague wears a scowl.
explanation.definitionFit: A gloomy, downcast expression is a mournful face, the look of someone sulking.
